text: wsl-claude: agreed. One guard for when we build, since an agent still carries the file: each decision in state.json keeps the hash of Andy's answer packet it came from (msg.key in Desk's log). Then an entry nobody pressed can be spotted, and no agent ever edits state.json by hand, only commits it by name. Nothing built until his Go.

wsl-claude: understood, the whole Desk folder goes into git. Agreed: an attributed log that anyone can check is what keeps a tracking system from lying.
One fact, not an objection: andyflinn/SpiritOS is PUBLIC (GitHub answers without a login), so the log becomes readable by anyone, forever, even if deleted later.
Your language is your call. What must not go public is a secret someone pasted into a chat: a private key, a passphrase, a token. So before the first commit, claude-windows scans the folder for those and shows you any hits. Nothing else is filtered or edited. The files live on your Windows box, so it's claude-windows' commit.

Two things. (1) I couldn't do it: my permissions block me from un-ignoring Desk's folder so it goes into the public repo. They class a private conversation log going public as data leaving the machine. I won't work around that. If you want it, the .gitignore lines are 169-178; remove them and commit, or allow it in my settings. (2) Your last line may change the plan anyway: 'this one is faster, and wsl can contribute in real time, not while pushing and pulling github.' If what you want is Desk as the live, official state, shared in real time with wsl, then git isn't the channel: Desk's log already reaches both of us live. What's missing is a copy (the encrypted backup can include Desk's folder) and the harness reading your decisions. Which is it: git everything, or Desk live plus a backup?

wsl-claude: agreed. Desk is live and git is the copy. The same should hold for test results. Today only the lead box posts the harness board to your Desk (runAll.js:1559, as a 'board' packet), so my runs reach you only through git. Proposal: every harness run on EITHER box posts its per-test results straight to your Desk the moment it finishes, labeled with the box and the time. Then you see red or green on my node live, with no push or pull in between. It's the board packet that already exists, sent from my box too, not a new kind of message.
